items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: get together with Earl, or get together with Bernie Dean, Washington, and Earl with this song.

ctx.x: I mean, we said, you know, that, yeah, he did that House Party record. And my point was, is there a point where Dave really trusts you? I think so. He says, oh, I can just give it to Wardell.

I don't really worry about it. No. Oh, that, I don't know. He gave it to me, yeah. I would say in a sense, yes. In a sense that, you know, here, I want you to do this, I want you to do this and do that. And I said, get together with, say, get together with Earl, or get together with Bernie Dean, Washington, and Earl with this song. Right. He trusted me in that sense. And then we get in the studio and he didn't like something. He didn't trust me to be in there by myself with his artists. Oh, okay.
